d: Asaduddin Owaisi's AIMIM and Chandrashekhar Azad's Azad Samaj Party (Kanshiram) have joined hands to form a new political alliance, Samajik Parivartan Morcha (SPM), ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. The alliance is set to contest all 403 Assembly seats, marking a new political development in Uttar Pradesh.
